response.sql: WITH funding_metrics AS (SELECT p.fundflux, AVG((sp.boxy - sp.boxx) / sp.boxx) AS avg_y_vs_x, SUM(sp.aream2) / SUM(sp.volm3) AS area_to_volume_ratio FROM projects p JOIN scanspatial sp ON p.arcregistry = sp.arcref WHERE sp.boxx IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxy IS NOT NULL AND sp.aream2 IS NOT NULL AND sp.volm3 IS NOT NULL AND sp.boxx > 0 AND sp.volm3 > 0 GROUP BY p.fundflux), average_ratio AS (SELECT AVG(area_to_volume_ratio) AS cross_avg FROM funding_metrics) SELECT fm.fundflux, fm.avg_y_vs_x, fm.area_to_volume_ratio, fm.area_to_volume_ratio - ar.cross_avg AS above_average FROM funding_metrics fm CROSS JOIN average_ratio ar WHERE fm.area_to_volume_ratio > ar.cross_avg ORDER BY fm.fundflux
